critical_findings.title: sync down --delete never deletes local files and can delete wrong remote object
critical_findings.fix: Branch Execute on plan.Direction: for SyncDown delete ops call os.Remove(op.LocalPath), never DeleteRemoteObject; regression-test that down-sync emits zero remote deletes

critical_findings.title: Shared 30s http.Client.Timeout kills large S3 transfers mid-body
critical_findings.fix: Dedicated timeout-free HTTP client for the S3 transport (ctx + SDK retries govern); keep 30s client for API calls

critical_findings.title: Multipart abort uses canceled request context, orphaning billed uploads
critical_findings.fix: Abort with context.WithoutCancel(ctx) + timeout; log abort failures (also multipart.go:467)

critical_findings.title: sync up --delete deletes remote objects matching exclude patterns
critical_findings.fix: Add isExcluded(relKey, input.Exclude) check in the planUp/planDown delete loops to protect excluded remote files

critical_findings.title: --include flag is a silent no-op (SyncPlanInput.Include never read)
critical_findings.fix: Implement include filtering in planUp/planDown or remove the flag from cmd/sync.go

critical_findings.title: apply deletes any account resource not declared in config (delete-by-omission)
critical_findings.fix: Only delete resources cosmoflare created (state-tracked/tagged) or require explicit --delete-unmanaged opt-in

critical_findings.title: KV namespaces assumed unique by title; duplicate titles delete wrong namespace
critical_findings.fix: Match namespaces by ID where available; refuse ambiguous duplicate-title operations

critical_findings.title: Machine config tokens written 0644 before chmod 0600 (TOCTOU/crash window)
critical_findings.fix: Write via os.OpenFile with 0600 perms instead of viper.WriteConfigAs + chmod

critical_findings.title: CopySource not URL-encoded; keys with spaces/+/ %/? break CopyObject
Interrupted downloads truncate pre-existing local files (no atomic write)
critical_findings.fix: Stream to temp file in target dir, sync+close with error check, then os.Rename (also cmd/sync.go:534)

critical_findings.title: Guardrails enforce uploads only; deletes and copies bypass them
Sync executor is strictly sequential (no worker pool)
critical_findings.fix: Bounded concurrent workers over plan.Operations with ordered error collection; est. 4-8x faster large syncs

critical_findings.title: restClient retry sleep ignores ctx; Retry-After unbounded
critical_findings.fix: Select on ctx.Done during delay; cap parseRetryAfter result at maxRetryBackoff

critical_findings.title: Diff skips drift for services absent from config (under-reporting)
critical_findings.fix: Run comparisons for explicitly-enabled services and report skipped services as unmanaged

critical_findings.title: Raw cmd.Start() fire-and-forget violates project spawn policy (ROAD-525)
critical_findings.fix: Use daemon.SpawnAsync or Start+Wait in a goroutine

recommendations.action: Direction-aware delete handling in SyncService.Execute with regression tests
Split control-plane vs data-plane HTTP clients (30s API, timeout-free S3)
Exclude-protected --delete loops plus implemented --include in sync planner
Atomic temp-file+rename downloads with Close() error checking
Extend guardrail enforcement to delete/copy paths
Managed-resource ownership model before apply deletions

roadmap_suggestions.title: Sync engine correctness hardening
roadmap_suggestions.description: Direction-aware deletes, exclude-protected deletions, working --include, atomic download writes — two data-loss-class bugs live in the flagship workflow

roadmap_suggestions.title: Large-transfer timeout architecture
roadmap_suggestions.description: Separate 30s control-plane client from context-driven data-plane client; slow-body integration test

roadmap_suggestions.title: Multipart upload lifecycle hygiene
roadmap_suggestions.description: Cancellation-safe aborts plus a doctor check that reaps orphaned incomplete multipart uploads

roadmap_suggestions.title: Guardrails v2: mutation-wide enforcement
roadmap_suggestions.description: Single guardrail chokepoint covering upload, delete, copy, and apply mutations

roadmap_suggestions.title: Apply safety model
roadmap_suggestions.description: State/tag-tracked managed resources so apply never deletes resources cosmoflare did not create

roadmap_suggestions.title: Parallel sync executor
roadmap_suggestions.description: Bounded worker pool with ordered error reporting; est. 4-8x wall-clock improvement on large syncs
